rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for an exercise jog or easy run.

example.english: I go for a jog by the waterfront in the morning.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ziu1 zou2 heoi3 hoi2 ban1 maan6 paau2

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for moving at a pace between walking and running.

example.english: I jog by the waterfront in the morning.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ziu1 zou2 heoi3 hoi2 pong4 maan6 paau2

rows.note: Use this when something helps bring a memory or fact back to mind.

example.english: This song helps jog my memory of my old life.
example.traditional: 呢首歌提醒我以前嘅生活。
example.jyutping: ni1 sau2 go1 tai4 sing2 ngo5 ji5 cin4 ge3 sang1 wut6

rows.note: Use this for a single sudden push or nudge, especially in expressions such as being given a push.

example.english: They nearly fell when someone gave them a jog.
example.jyutping: keoi5 bei2 jan4 jat1 teoi1 caa1 di1 dit3 can1

rows.note: Use this for giving someone or something a slight physical push or nudge, not for jogging a memory or running.

example.english: Can you give the table a little jog so I can get my pen?
example.traditional: 你推一推張枱，等我攞返支筆。
example.jyutping: nei5 teoi1 jat1 teoi1 zoeng1 toi2 dang2 ngo5 lo2 faan1 zi1 bat1
